# MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Machining radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01

Scope
This procedure covers lubrication and fluid handling for the machining radial ring rolling mill identified as EQ-P2-L3-RR01. The maximum ring outer diameter for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 1310 mm. Follow the maintenance boundaries defined in MM-P2-L3-RR01 and the safety guidance in SB-1036. Process and permit steps reference SOP-P2-L3-05.

Tools
- Personal protective equipment as required by SB-1036.
- Approved lubricant dispenser and funnel compatible with CFW-LUB-225.
- Clean collection container for waste fluids marked per SB-1036.
- Lint-free cleaning cloth and spill absorbent.

Procedure
- Verify machine is in a secured state per SOP-P2-L3-05 before any fluid or lubrication task. Lockout and tagout requirements are enforced as directed by SOP-P2-L3-05 and SB-1036.
- Inspect reservoirs and visible feed lines for contamination or leaks. Use lint-free cloth to remove surface debris; capture any drained fluid in the collection container.
- Replace lubricant with CFW-LUB-225 only. Dispense lubricant from an approved container using the approved dispenser. Avoid cross-contamination by purging dispenser per manufacturer practice and as referenced in MM-P2-L3-RR01.
- Record lubricant addition and source in the equipment lubrication log. Retain used containers and waste fluids and handle according to SB-1036 disposal requirements.
- After servicing, restore machine to operational readiness following SOP-P2-L3-05 verification steps.

Acceptance criteria
- Reservoirs contain only CFW-LUB-225 and show no visible contamination after servicing.
- No uncontrolled leaks or drips present on adjacent structure or floor; any collected waste is stored per SB-1036.
- Equipment tags and logs updated to reflect service activity in accordance with MM-P2-L3-RR01 and SOP-P2-L3-05.
- Machine passes post-service verification steps in SOP-P2-L3-05 prior to return to production.
